modifications: Unrigged Tripo export in 19 parts (389,818 triangles, three 2048 px textures: base colour, metal/roughness, normal map; one double-sided material), standing on four feet facing -X. Welded across UV seams and the seams between parts (403 edges split at T-junctions, 35 pinholes filled), decimated as one mesh with the head keeping relatively more detail, and split back into its 19 parts: 38,000 triangles, closed (remake/tools/blender-decimate.py ... parts, Blender 5.2, the script as rewritten on branch gramedla, d919175; kept as source/stegosaurus-parts.glb). Baked by remake/tools/bake/bake-quadruped.js (run with bake-character.mjs): turned to face +X, scaled to 7 m long (3.74 m high), stood on the ground with the root midway between the feet, the parts told apart by position (body, head and neck, four legs; 11 plates and the two pairs of tail spikes ride rigidly on the bone under their base, seam and all, the skin around their foot blending out from that bone), rigged with 21 bones, welded into one closed, consistently wound skin (4 zero-area slivers dropped) whose seams share their weights, a float attribute plateRow marking the plates in three rows from the head (0 elsewhere; _PLATEROW in the GLB), five clips authored in code (quadruped-clips.js), merged into one skinned mesh with one matte single-sided material (roughness 0.62, no metalness, normal map at 0.5), base colour (no recolour) and normal map as 1024 px JPEG, the metal/roughness map dropped. Then the face pass and the mouth pass (below).
rig: Our bake tool for quadrupeds. Bones: root, Hips, Spine, Chest, Neck, Neck2, Head, Tail1-Tail6, and for each leg one rigid bone hanging from the root with the foot below it, named as the engine's footing plants them: BackLeg.L/R, BackFoot.L/R, FrontLeg.L/R, FrontFoot.L/R; the Jaw from the mouth pass under the Head; identity rest rotations. A leg swings from a pivot on its axis at half the height (1.87 m); the skin blends from the leg into the body between the top of the leg part and the pivot, and the body around it follows as a harmonic field. Clips: idle 4.0 s; walk 2.43 s, 2.21 m a cycle (0.91 m/s; four beats in lateral sequence, a foot down 55 % of the cycle, landing flat and sweeping back at exactly that speed, passing under its pivot; the hips and shoulders ride as high as their planted legs reach); kink 2.4 s (a friendly nod: the chin lifts a little, the head dips 25 degrees and then less, and comes back); eat 2.0 s (the head comes down in front of her until the mouth is 1.0 m above the ground and 1.5 m ahead of the fore feet, nips, chews three times and goes back up); happy 1.5 s (a crouch, a hop that lifts all four feet 9 cm for about 0.4 s, a soft landing and a wiggle; the clip keys the legs). The feet stay planted in idle, kink and eat; in a scene the engine's footing plants them in walks, starts, stops and turns on the spot. Plate mask: the float attribute plateRow (_PLATEROW in the GLB, geometry.attributes._platerow in three) is 0 off the plates and 1 to 3 on the back plates, counted from the head in rows of about equal plate area: 1 the six plates on the neck and shoulders, 2 the two big back plates, 3 the three on the hips and tail; the tail spikes are 0.
pose: Rest pose on four feet, head, back and tail level, two staggered rows of plates and four tail spikes; faces -X; 0.98 units long, 0.52 high.
sourceTextures: three 2048 px JPEG: base colour, metal/roughness, normal map; one double-sided material
lookCheck: qa/remake/shots/kambedla-look/ (with her beside Mosi at 8.5 m and Egill at 1.1 m: grunnur review shots lineup, three, face, hero, behind, walk and kink; lineup-chapter/ for chapter=lineup with Grameðla too: lineup, kambedla, kambedlaSide), qa/remake/shots/kambedla-r1/ and kambedla-r2/ (rig, weights, walk, nod, eat, happy, the plate rows lit one by one, look turns, back faces in magenta), qa/remake/shots/kambedla-look/chapter1/ (eating from Egill's hand, hopping) and qa/remake/shots/stego-look/ (the source as received). qa/remake/kambedla-mouth/ (the mouth pass: the mouth line, hinge and cut on gridded side views of both sides, slices of her snout, the mouth shut and open 6 and 15 degrees, the jaw's weights, the eat clip's nip and chews; chapter 1 at the tablet preset: overEgill shut and talking, the plates lit one row, two and all three after the third flower, the glow line; the maps before and after).
budget: GPU at the tablet preset, 1280x800 on the Iris Xe laptop, __benchmark medians, runs with and without her interleaved in one page load (six rounds each): she adds 0.3 to 1.6 ms, median about 0.8 (her face filling the frame about 1.1), nearly all of it the lit material where she covers the frame; 30k instead of 38k triangles, no shadow, no normal map or drawing the characters first each change it by 0.3 ms or less. Whole frames with her are over 6 ms in most loads: grunnur review shots and the scene at t=24 5.5 to 8.2 ms (4.6 to 7.1 without her), chapter=lineup with all four characters 6.2 to 8.5 ms (5.2 to 7.8 without her). The laptop read about 1 ms slower than the scene measured that morning (warm after long benchmark runs, the GPU shared with other sessions). Triangles, shadow pass included: 277k to 305k in grunnur (201k to 229k without her), 359k to 413k in the lineup.
notes: Violet body, plum back, lilac-cream belly, lilac plates and ivory spikes, as in the concept and STYLE.md section 3 (the row takes its values from this model). Friendly face, closed smile, no teeth; her beak opens a little when she talks (the mouth pass, 2026-10-17). Real adult size: 7 m from nose to tail tip.
facePass: Eyes found in the colour map by remake/tools/bake/face.js (eyes.js) and written into the GLB as extras on the skinned mesh (face.eyes: per eye its centre, frame, outline and lid and lash colours, in bind space), for the eyelids the engine builds in code (engine/eyelids.js). Geometry and textures unchanged (2026-10-15).
mouthPass: A jaw cut by remake/tools/bake/mouth.js (2026-10-17, the owner: she did not move her mouth when she talked): her beak and lower jaw belong to the head part, so the pass splits the triangles along her smile (the line given in the head frame, read off gridded side views of both sides and the slit between her lips measured slice by slice, where a level cut crosses each lip once: from behind the corner of her smile along the bottom of that slit, then along the edge of her upper beak to its hook at f = 0.378 m; her two sides differ by up to a centimetre, so left= gives her left side its own line, the two meeting at the beak) in front of f = 0.06, just ahead of the corners of her smile, gives the jaw side its own vertices there (37 triangles split and 1 beside them, 44 lip vertices opened; snap=0.002 counts vertices within 2 mm of the line as on it), adds a Jaw bone under the Head at the hinge (f = -0.18, u = -0.27: 2.045, 1.814, 0.005 m), blends the jaw in from the hinge to the cut, fills the mouth with a pocket (palate and tongue painted into a free corner of the colour map; 720 triangles) and writes face.mouth.talk = 8 (degrees the jaw opens at the loudest syllable, as Þórseðla's). No teeth. rim=1 (new): the pocket's edge follows the rim of the opening edge by edge and its rows start from the lips, so the deep slit of her smile leaves no hole between the pocket and the lips and no flap across the open mouth; conform=1 (new): the triangle the cut left whole beside a split one is split too, so no crack opens on her cheek as the jaw turns; keep=1 (new): the painted maps keep their names, repeat wrapping and filters; corners=1. The pass carries the skin's other attributes (new): _PLATEROW keeps every vertex's row (1,609, 1,758 and 1,031 vertices in rows 1 to 3, as before; the cut's vertices and the pocket are 0). The bake's bones, rest pose and inverse bind matrices, the five clips (the jaw in none: it opens when she talks), the face extras and the material are as they were; 38,774 triangles and 24,188 vertices in all (572 more vertices, 778 more triangles). With the mouth shut the pocket shows as a thin dark-red line at the bottom of her smile's slit, close up. The maps are re-encoded as 1024 px JPEG (outside the painted corner the colour map changes by 0.4 of 255 on average, at most 14, the normal map by 1.3, at most 25, at the islands' edges). Re-exported with GLTFExporter, node names kept.
passes: decimateCommand, then bakeCommand, then faceCommand, then mouthCommand (the mouth pass takes its head frame from the eyes the face pass writes). The mouth command run twice on the face pass's GLB gives the same file but for the order of its two maps in the binary, which the exporter writes as their encodings finish.
